title: Knowledge Base Builder
subtitle: This agent questions an AI model topic by topic, finds the thin areas, proposes new entries, keeps only the ones that pass a quality bar, and deepens weak topics until the knowledge base is full.
lede: This agent questions an AI model topic by topic, finds the thin areas, proposes new entries, keeps only the ones that pass a quality bar, and deepens weak topics until the knowledge base is full.
who: A research lead or knowledge manager who wants an AI model's knowledge written down
author: Corey James
